run_train_dreambooth_flux2_lora: run the dreambooth training script to fine-tune a FLUX.2 model with LoRA adapters on custom images
create_DreamBoothDataset: create a DreamBoothDataset instance that loads and preprocesses instance and class images with aspect-ratio buckets
